Before You Continue

    {% if form.name %}
  1. Choose the correct managing office. Its administrators maintain this external office entry.
  2. External offices do not receive accounts. Contact details identify the paper's counterpart.
  3. History is preserved. Renaming or deactivating an office does not rewrite earlier movements.
    4. {% else %}
  4. External records stay separate. This case belongs to External Tracking and, after filing, the External Repository.
  5. External updates are recorded manually. Authorized administrators record receipt and work updates for offices without access to DocTrack.
  6. Internal receipt uses server time. Internal recipients confirm their own receipt and carry out their permitted actions.
  7. Use known paper times. Actual event time and who recorded it are kept separately. Do not invent missing history.
